The announced asset disposition includes defined cash consideration and a retained royalty interest with a buyout option, while the closing date, final adjustments, and exercise of the option are not established in the bundle.

Among the counted names, 6 ran at least 50 percent above the prior close, and 5 of them kept at least half of the peak gain at the close. The two covered 50 percent movers with the highest peaks were AMOD, with fresh news found in our sources: completion of a shares-for-Bitcoin PIPE in which its subsidiary received 3,170 Bitcoin, and CYCU, with fresh news found in our sources: Nasdaq compliance with the $1.00 minimum-bid requirement. After the close, MI added 14 percent. 5 of the 12 names the desk covers had fresh news in our sources. Overbought here.
